articles.headline: GUILD BREAK-IN INQUIRY FILED
articles.body: The Watch has filed its inquiry into the reported guild break-ins. This public notice confirms the report was filed; it does not turn an allegation or an unverified connection into a conviction.

articles.headline: Watch Checks Reports of Armed Assaults
articles.body: The Watch is checking reports of two armed assaults along its patrol route. Commander Vimes holds the assignment. The accounts must be checked, the people involved identified and surrender sought where possible. A report in this paper is not authority to arrest a passer-by.
